review: Both original files were read completely and match the pinned public Git blobs. Root MIT applies; no additional per-file notices. Preserve both complete upstream notices; contents unchanged.

Original spacer is geometry-only. Base exposes setting/broadcast helpers but has no startup hook, process, file IO, service, IPC, font or theme probe. Its Style fallback must not resolve to the original Style.

Only the authored passive Style adapter is exported as qs.Commons.Style; only the unchanged base is exported as qs.Ui.BarWidget. No original Commons/qmldir, Style, Color, I18n, registry or other UI is staged.

The API supplies readonly vertical/barSize views over a frozen validated data snapshot. snapshotJson remains constructor-owner input, not an untrusted live configuration interface. This is not an OS sandbox.
Probe instrumentation adds a constructor marker to the authored Style adapter only, to detect an unexpected fallback. No upstream content is instrumented or patched.
limits: No window or rendering. QtQuick Item geometry only in the established contained runtime.
No original bar, clock/calendar, shared startup, command routes, services, auth, helpers, fonts/assets or host integration are admitted.
This sealed namespace is an explicit incomplete adaptation, not stock Commons/Style behavior or original-shell parity.
The production guard/catalog is unchanged and empty. Source import is not permission for activation, graphics, deployment or publication.
